ABOUT

I. GENERAL
Women in the history of human life have indeed been in a disadvantageous condition. This means that in social community life, women have always been the party that is placed second after men, and even more tragically, the history of women in their social life can be said to have experienced a concerning historical condition.
In its development, although it can be said that the struggle of women has been quite successful, it needs to receive vigilance. This means that women must always be protected from actions that harm them due to their vulnerable condition. Women as a national asset who play a role in the process of continuation and creation of quality generations need to receive guarantees for the fulfillment of their rights and protection from acts of violence and discrimination.
In addition to women needing to be protected, and in their development increasingly being able to protect themselves, women must be empowered. This empowerment is importantly aimed at gender equality, namely a condition of equality for men and women to obtain opportunities and their rights as human beings so they are able to play a role and participate in political, economic, socio-cultural activities, national defense and security, and equality in enjoying the results of development.

Women in the history of human life have indeed been in a disadvantageous condition. I. GENERAL
Women in the history of human life have indeed been in a disadvantageous condition. This means that in social community life, women have always been the party that is placed second after men, and even more tragically, the history of women in their social life can be said to have experienced a concerning historical condition.
In its development, although it can be said that the struggle of women has been quite successful, it needs to receive vigilance. This means that women must always be protected from actions that harm them due to their vulnerable condition. Women as a national asset who play a role in the process of continuation and creation of quality generations need to receive guarantees for the fulfillment of their rights and protection from acts of violence and discrimination.
In addition to women needing to be protected, and in their development increasingly being able to protect themselves, women must be empowered. This empowerment is importantly aimed at gender equality, namely a condition of equality for men and women to obtain opportunities and their rights as human beings so they are able to play a role and participate in political, economic, socio-cultural activities, national defense and security, and equality in enjoying the results of development.

(1) In order to improve the position, role, and quality of women, as well as efforts to realize equality and gender justice in family life, society, nationhood, and statehood, women must be empowered.
(2) The empowerment of women as referred to in paragraph (1) is directed toward obtaining opportunities and their rights as human beings, to be able to play a role and participate in political, economic, socio-cultural activities, national defense and security, and equality in enjoying the results of development.

ABOUT
THE PROTECTION AND EMPOWERMENT OF WOMEN
I. GENERAL
Women in the history of human life have indeed been in a disadvantageous condition. This means that in social community life, women have always been the party that is placed second after men, and even more tragically, the history of women in their social life can be said to have experienced a concerning historical condition.
In its development, although it can be said that the struggle of women has been quite successful, it needs to receive vigilance. This means that women must always be protected from actions that harm them due to their vulnerable condition. Women as a national asset who play a role in the process of continuation and creation of quality generations need to receive guarantees for the fulfillment of their rights and protection from acts of violence and discrimination.
In addition to women needing to be protected, and in their development increasingly being able to protect themselves, women must be empowered. This empowerment is importantly aimed at gender equality, namely a condition of equality for men and women to obtain opportunities and their rights as human beings so they are able to play a role and participate in political, economic, socio-cultural activities, national defense and security, and equality in enjoying the results of development.

CHAPTER VII
MONITORING AND EVALUATION
Article 21
(1) To guarantee synergy, continuity, and effectiveness of integrated measures in the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women, the Regional Government conducts monitoring.

(2) Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) is intended to determine progress in the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women in the region.

(3) Monitoring is conducted periodically through coordination and direct monitoring of Regional Work Units that implement policies, programs and activities for the protection of women.

(4) Monitoring is conducted from the planning stage through to the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the protection of women for the current year.

Article 22
(1) Evaluation of the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women is conducted at the end of each fiscal year.

(2) The results of the evaluation of the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women are used as input material for the formulation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women for the following year.

(3) Evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) is implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.
